professional: Register: professional — Write the same message as a careful professional would type: precise wording, complete sentences, a courteous tone, and real rewording; keep every fact, hedge, negation and intent exactly as spoken. If what was said is a fragment, a single word or a short reply, keep it that short and only reword it. Keep a question a question, with the same yes/no sense: "didn't we…?" stays negative. Never add facts, greetings, requests or sentences the speaker did not say; keep names, product names and numbers exactly.
